Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning reimbursement of prenatal and well-child visits for rural health clinics.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reimbursement of prenatal and wellchild visitsfor rural health clinics; adding a new section to chapter 74.09 RCW;and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Effective January 1, 2011, a federally designated rural healthclinic must be paid the costbased encounter rate for prenatal andwellchild visits whether delivered under a managed care contract orfeeforservice. (2) In reconciling managed care enhancement payments for calendaryears 2009 and 2010, the department must treat wellchild and prenatalcare visits delivered by federally designated rural health clinics asencounters subject to the clinic's encounter rate for purposes of therate reconciliation.

This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of the p. 1 SB 5682state government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
